meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye **rich, fragrance-free cream moisturizer** kharidein—gel nahi. Label par **ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid**, aur bahut zyada dryness ho to **shea butter ya petrolatum** dekhein; ye skin barrier ko support karke moisture lock karte hain.[1][3]

**Achhe options:**
- **Cetaphil Moisturising Cream** — very dry/sensitive skin ke liye  
- **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** — ceramides + hyaluronic acid  
- **Bioderma Atoderm Creme** — dry/sensitive skin ke liye  
- **Venusia Max Cream** — budget-friendly rich option  
- **Physiogel Daily Moisture Therapy Cream** — irritated ya sensitive skin ke liye  

**Kaise lagayein:** Face wash ke turant baad halki damp skin par, subah aur raat. Din mein **SPF 30+ sunscreen** bhi lagayein. Bahut flaky areas par raat ko moisturizer ke upar petroleum jelly ki patli layer laga sakte hain.[3][5]

Agar acne-prone skin hai, to **non-comedogenic** cream chunhein; itching, redness ya cracks zyada hon to dermatologist ko dikhayein.
